theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_lipschitz_c1_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid m → ℝ) (K : NNReal), LipschitzWith K u → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ G : Euclid m → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 G ∧ volume {y | u y ≠ G y} < ε
